components.text: The [color=yellow]Electrolyzer [color]is a machine that can be used to produce oxygen and hydrogen from water. It is commonly used in space stations and other structures to provide a sustainable source of breathable air and fuel.

[br] [br] How to use : [br] Place the electrolyzer. Connect the machine to a power source, then open the GUI tto insert water in the second slot. The machine start producing oxygen and hydrogen automatically.
